artifact_groups.rationale: Konigsberg-inspired islands and bridges introduce what a graph is; two compact artifacts on separate platforms
Single artifact on asymmetric platforms; room topology itself demonstrates force-directed equilibrium
Single artifact in maze corridor; player embodies the pathfinding algorithm through spatial navigation
Hub-and-spoke topology with three artifacts; network flow and analysis from the heart of the graph
Three connected rooms as strongly connected components; one algorithm artifact per room
Scattered platforms at varying heights connected by walkways; single MST artifact on central elevated platform
Funnel narrows from wide entrance to tight exit; single artifact demonstrates flow constraints
Symmetric room with perfect left-right mirror; single matching artifact at the symmetry axis
